{{Youmay|the children|''[[The Lost (article)|The Lost]]'', the [[Wizards.com]] article, or [[Lost Twenty/Legends|The Lost]], a term used to describe individuals who had resigned from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]}}
'''The Lost''' was a term that was used to collectively describe the abandoned children of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Some of the children were former [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] that had been abandoned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]], while others had ran away from their homes, and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], there were between 1,500 and 2,000 such children living across the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]]. A number of individuals known as [[Watcher (The Lost)|watchers]] kept an eye on the children, such as [[Dani (Cularin)|Dani]], who watched over the children of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and [[Ariella]], who cared for seventy children living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Lora Nadad]], a former watcher, attempted to bring the plight of the Lost into the public conciousness of the people of the Cularin system.
